newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia TV3 suspended pending news-KLSE.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia TV3 suspended pending news-KLSE.

text.p: Broadcasting group Sistem Televisyen Malaysia Bhd said on Friday it was requesting the suspension from trading of its shares pending a news announcement.
The popular station, better known as TV3, did not detail the reason for the suspension in its statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE)
Officials at the company were not available for immediate comment.
The stock was last traded at 5.70 ringgit.
The market has speculated that telecommunications giant Telekom Malaysia Bhd may be interested to buy a stake in TV3 to expand its multimedia operations.
On Wednesday, Telekom chief executive Mohamed Said Mohamed Ali told reporters the company was considering to take up a stake in a television broadcasting company.
But he said the TV company targeted could be a local or foreign one.
Telekom shares were up 10 cents at 22.40 ringgit at around 0210 GMT.
